text:
maria: quick heads-up — ran a regression bench last night for the new rwd-30b-qlora bring-up (q4f16 path). saw an unexpected p99 spike in ap-southeast-1 on H100s around 03:10 UTC. attaching the tiny csv dump below for context

maria: ```region,gpu,bs,p50(ms),p95(ms),p99(ms),tokens_per_s
us-west-2,H100,1,28,56,78,1250
ap-southeast-1,H100,1,34,120,188,880
eu-west-1,A100,1,30,64,95,1100
us-west-2,H100,4,45,90,130,3200
ap-southeast-1,H100,4,62,180,260,2100```

kenji: hmm that's a pretty large p99 gap (H100 apac 188ms vs us 78ms). was batch shape identical and were KV caches warmed?

maria: batch shapes + prompt length distribution identical. KV warm caches primed (we replayed last-night traffic). bs=1 and bs=4 runs both show same relative delta.

aj: do we know the kernel flavor used in ap-southeast? last deploy changed cuBLAS fallback on that fleet for a micro-optim earlier.

maria: checked — ap-southeast H100s are running kernel-set v2.9.1 (auto-picked). us-west is on v2.8.4. I also saw a different tile-split heuristic on v2.9.1 for seq len > 1024.

kenji: that lines up — tile-split can blow up p99 if the heuristic underestimates memory and forces different kernel selection mid-run. can you paste model sequence distro?

maria: 95% of requests <=512 tokens, 4% 512-1024, 1% >1024. the p99 cluster seems correlated to the 1% tail.

irene: also flagging quality: eval-suite on the q4f16 build showed a small generation-quality regression vs float16 baseline — ~1.2% drop on factuality for the news dataset. not huge but worth noting if we decide to route traffic to the quant path.

aj: operationally: we need a short runway change for Dedicated APAC pool. proposal: +2 H100 GPUs now and lower per-GPU concurrency target from 36->30 for 24h while we root-cause. Also add a canary policy to route 5% traffic to v2.8.4 kernel on apac. thoughts? :thinking_face:

kenji: +1 on canary. Also we should force kernel v2.8.4 on a single AZ slab (no config drift) and re-run the same bench with trace-level logs. If p99 drops we're golden.

maria: I can schedule the bench to run in 20m and include perf traces. For capacity numbers, here's a rough CPU/GPU sizing note from the bench aggregated: ```gpu_type,concurrency_target,est_p99(ms),est_tokens_s_per_gpu
H100,36,80,40k
H100,30,95,34k
A100,30,110,30k
```

aj: based on that, short-term routing change: keep committed capacity but reduce the per-GPU concurrency soft-limit to 30 for apac and add +2 GPUs as buffer. autoscale headroom: set scale-up threshold at 65% of capacity (instead of 80%) for next 12 hours to be conservative.

irene: if we push more traffic to q4f16 we need to gate by eval checks. propose a rollback trigger: if nightly eval delta > 0.8% factuality drop or >1.5% hallucination increase, auto-roll back to float16 pool.

ops-bot: [alert] autoscaler triggered: added 2 x H100 to ap-southeast-1 pool at 03:22 UTC (policy: emergency-buffer).

maria: thanks — I'll post the full bench logs to the eng-platform-runbooks channel after traces complete. Next steps: kenji will pin a canary AZ to v2.8.4, aj will apply soft-limit/concurrency and scale policy, irene will run the nightly eval gating.

kenji: starting the canary now. grabbing a snapshot and will run identical load generator to reproduce.

aj: I'll update the dedicated provisioning board and leave a note for oncall to monitor p99 and OOMs.

maria: quick note — if kernel v2.8.4 fixes it we'll need to reconcile the kernel heuristic changes into v2.9.x rather than pin indefinitely. filing a kernel-bisect ticket after this. :memo:
